title: Work With Me — Get Real Integrative Health

title: What Is Integrative Health? — Get Real Integrative Health
description: Integrative health looks at the whole person, not one symptom at a time. It brings together conventional care and evidence-informed natural approaches like nutrition, botanicals, and lifestyle, so every part of your health is working in the same direction.

description: Free guides that teach you to read your own signals, in the order I'd hand them to you. No sign-up, no strings.
